name: Stefanos Tsitsipas
intro: Stefanos Tsitsipas is a tall tennis star from Athens, Greece. He has long, flowing hair. He has played in two Grand Slam finals, the biggest tournaments in tennis.
story: His mom was a pro player. His dad is his coach. At 21 he won the big year-end ATP Finals. He has won the Monte Carlo tournament three times. On Friday he lost the first set, then roared back to win in four.

funFacts.text: He speaks three languages: Greek, English, and Russian.
He makes YouTube travel videos and edits them himself.
He loves photography and always has a camera on the road.
He has two brothers and a sister. They all play tennis too!
His grandpa won an Olympic gold medal in soccer in 1956.
He shares a birthday with tennis legend Pete Sampras.
He cheers for the Milwaukee Bucks basketball team.

watchFor: Watch his rare one-handed backhand, swung with one arm like a sword.
